description: Creates an EMPTY Function Block (empty interface, no logic) by importing a minimal SimaticML skeleton. Supported languages: SCL (the default when `language` is omitted), LAD, FBD, STL or ProDiag, in any case; any other value is refused with 400 bad_request listing them, and a CPU family can still refuse one it does not support. Gd6: for LOGIC use a textual language (SCL) via tia_source_put, or graphical (LAD/FBD) via tia_import_xml. Refused with 409 name_collision (details.collidesWith = the colliding tag, constant or block) when the name matches, ignoring case, any tag, constant or block of the PLC. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/fbs. M-off.

autoNumber.description: accepted for compatibility and ignored: without 'number' the serve picks the number itself

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

language.description: SCL (default when omitted), LAD, FBD, STL or ProDiag; any case

number.description: block number ≥1, used as given (a number another FB holds is refused by TIA); omitted or 0 ⇒ the serve picks the lowest free number from 1 in the FB family (409 block_number_exhausted when none is free)

name: tia_fb_create
title: TIA — create FB
